crossRefs.note: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and…
He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.
The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will…
You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Yahweh brought back the…
The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.
By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

translations.web: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how Yahweh has destroyed them to this day;
translations.bsb: what He did to the Egyptian army and horses and chariots when He made the waters of the Red Sea engulf them as they pursued you, and how He destroyed them completely, even to this day;
translations.kjv: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;
translations.asv: and what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how Jehovah hath destroyed them unto this day;
